_comment: ComfyUI API-format workflow: animate the avatar still into a 5-second head clip with Wan 2.2 TI2V 5B (image-to-video). Uses the Q4_K_M GGUF that already sits in ~/.cache/huggingface/hub/models--unsloth--Wan2.2-TI2V-5B-GGUF; copy it to ComfyUI/models/unet/. Needs the ComfyUI-GGUF custom node (node 1) plus two Comfy-Org files: models/text_encoders/umt5_xxl_fp8_e4m3fn_scaled.safetensors and models/vae/wan2.2_vae.safetensors. Node 5 = the start image (upload it first, run.py does that with --image). Node 6 sets size/length: 1280x704 or 704x1280 (shorts), 121 frames = 5 s at 24 fps. This is a subtle idle/talking motion pass, not lip-sync; mark lip-sync UNVERIFIED per hermes-youtube-avatar-head unless a lip-sync stage is added.

_meta.title: Start image = the avatar still (in ComfyUI/input)

inputs.text: the illustrated character speaks to the camera with natural subtle head movement, gentle blinking, small confident nods, mouth moving as if talking, steady framing, consistent character design, soft studio light, smooth motion, no camera movement
camera pan, camera zoom, scene change, second person, extra limbs, distorted face, flicker, blur, text, watermark, logo, low quality, static image, frozen
